correctness.rationale: From \(W\dot{}=i\omega_1W\) and \(V\dot{}=i\omega_2V\), the derivatives of \(|W|^2,|V|^2\) vanish and \(\dot K=i(\omega_2-2\omega_1)K=0\). The printed forcing yields \(W=e^{i\omega_1t}\), \(V=e^{2i\omega_1t}\), so \(K=1\) for every common time translate. The panel initial state \((w,p,z,q)=(4/5,3/5,4/5,3/5)\) gives \(W=(4+3i)/5\), \(V=(3+4i)/5\), and exact multiplication gives \(K=(117-44i)/125\). The retrieved source Figure 11 caption confirms these oscillator initial values and frequencies. The actual verify.py was inspected, and independent symbolic Lie-derivative/rational checks reproduced the conserved quantities and exact value; no Lyapunov numerics are used.

final_claim: On the resonance \(\omega_2=2\omega_1\ne0\), the oscillator extension of Liu--Feng--Chen--Huang has conserved \(I_1=|W|^2\), \(I_2=|V|^2\), and \(K=V\overline W^2\), where \(W=w+ip\) and \(V=q+iz\). The periodically forced model and all its common time translations have \(K=1\), whereas the published Figure 11(b) oscillator initial data give \(K=(117-44i)/125\ne1\); therefore the two figure panels use distinct relative phase leaves and are not pointwise equivalent as forced systems without an additional phase-independence theorem.
